source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of multiple alleles, block for block (PDF 92).

blocks.text: Multiple allelic system tab hota hai jab aabadi (population) mein kisi gene ki do se zyada mukhtalif shaklein (alleles) hon. Is se khasiyaton mein zyada farq (variation) aata hai.

Is ki misaal insanon ka ABO blood group system hai. Ise aik gene (I gene) control karta hai jis ke teen alleles hain: Iᴬ, Iᴮ aur i. Har shakhs ke paas in mein se sirf do alleles hote hain. Mukhtalif jore chaar blood groups banate hain:

blocks.caption: ABO blood groups ke phenotypes aur genotypes

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Insanon ke ABO blood group system mein alleles Iᴬ aur Iᴮ co-dominance bhi dikhate hain (IᴬIᴮ mein A aur B dono antigens).

blocks.prompt: Teen ABO alleles se kitne mukhtalif genotypes ban sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Chhe: IᴬIᴬ, Iᴬi, IᴮIᴮ, Iᴮi, IᴬIᴮ aur ii. Yeh chaar phenotypes (A, B, AB, O) dete hain.

items: Multiple alleles: aabadi mein do se zyada alleles, lekin har shakhs mein sirf do.
ABO: Iᴬ, Iᴮ, i; chhe genotypes, chaar blood groups; Iᴬ aur Iᴮ co-dominant.
